summary: Detailed implementation plan for: (1) Removing discontinued 3.5 Flash & 3.7 Flash models while passing all active models directly through normalizeGeminiModel without forced 2.5 downgrades, (2) Implementing descending model fallback chains (3.8 -> 3.6 -> 3.0 -> 2.5 for Flash; 3.5 Lite -> 3.1 Lite -> 2.5 Lite for Flash Lite) across all AI features in backendHelpers.ts and jarvisRoutes.ts, (3) Adding a subtle, non-eye-catchy short model name indicator at the bottom-right of each AI Tutor reply bubble, and (4) Speed optimizations via 60s server-side global_gemini config caching and local streaming state buffering before writing to useChatStore.
